% Hand-edited layout for the PDF resume. Content comes from app/resume/source.ts;
% run `npm run resume:tex` to regenerate main.tex. Do not edit main.tex directly.

\documentclass[margin,line]{style}
% Base font size (10.95pt is LaTeX's standard "11pt"; scrextend also allows sizes like 10.5pt).
\usepackage[fontsize=10.95pt]{scrextend}

% Page geometry: the same margin on all four sides (US Letter).
% If an update overflows to 2 pages: shorten text first, then lower the font size or margin.
% Content is vertically centered, so top and bottom margins stay equal.
% Width of the left-hand section-label column (style.cls default for `margin` is 1.3in).
\newsectionwidth{1.1in}
\newlength{\pagemargin}\setlength{\pagemargin}{0.55in}
\setlength{\topmargin}{\dimexpr\pagemargin-1in\relax}
\setlength{\oddsidemargin}{\dimexpr\pagemargin-1in\relax}
\setlength{\headheight}{0pt}\setlength{\headsep}{0pt}\setlength{\footskip}{0pt}
\setlength{\textheight}{\dimexpr\paperheight-2\pagemargin\relax}
% \hoffset (= the section-label column, set by style.cls) sits inside the left margin area.
\setlength{\textwidth}{\dimexpr\paperwidth-2\pagemargin-\hoffset\relax}
\itemsep=0in
\parsep=0in

\usepackage[pdftex]{hyperref}
\hypersetup{
    colorlinks,
    citecolor=blue,
    filecolor=blue,
    linkcolor=blue,
    urlcolor=blue
}

% NOTE: Use this for lists without a header
\newenvironment{list2}
    {
        \vspace{-1em}
        \begin{list}{$\bullet$}{
            \setlength{\itemsep}{0.3em}
            \setlength{\parsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\parskip}{0in}
            \setlength{\topsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\partopsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\leftmargin}{0.2in}
        }
    }
    {
        \end{list}
    }

% NOTE: Use this for lists with a header   
\newenvironment{list3}
    {
        \begin{list}{$\bullet$}{
            \setlength{\itemsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\parsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\parskip}{0in}
            \setlength{\topsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\partopsep}{0in}
            \setlength{\leftmargin}{0.2in}
        }
    }
    {
        \end{list}
    }

% For "C++"
\def\CC{{C\nolinebreak[4]\hspace{-.05em}\raisebox{.4ex}{\tiny\bf ++}}}
% \newcommand{\CC}{C\nolinebreak\hspace{-.05em}\raisebox{.4ex}{\tiny\bf +}\nolinebreak\hspace{-.10em}\raisebox{.4ex}{\tiny\bf +}}

%\renewcommand{\thefootnote}{\fnsymbol{footnote}}
\begin{document}

% (undo \topskip and \parskip so the fills alone set the top margin)
\vspace*{\fill}\vskip-\topskip\vskip-\parskip\nointerlineskip
%%HEADER%%

\begin{resume}

%%BODY%%

\end{resume}
\vspace*{\fill}

\end{document}
